documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Meeting Of Executive Committee Of The Board Of Bhagyanagar India Limited Held On 13.08.2026 - Preferential Allotment Of Equity Shares
In-Principle Approval Under Regulation 28(1) Of SEBI ( LODR) Regulations, 2015
Corrigendum To Extra-Ordinary General Meeting ("EGM") Notice, Dated 30.06.2026
Submission Of Voting Results Along With Scrutinizer Report

analysis.summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited reported a strong Q1 FY27 with a turnover exceeding 700 crores and higher EBITDA and PAT margins, driven by temporary market shortages despite lower sales volumes. Management highlighted ongoing restructuring through the creation of Tieramet Limited to unlock value in the copper business, alongside plans for capacity expansion and digital transformation. The company maintains a positive outlook for the copper and value-added product sectors, backed by growing demand from data centers and transformers. Bhagyanagar India Limited released its Q1FY27 investor presentation highlighting its financial performance, corporate restructuring scheme involving Bhagyanagar Copper Private Limited and Tieramet Ltd, and a preferential equity issue of Rs. 52.25 crores.

guidance.claim: Management projects a volume growth of 12% to 15% for the entire year.
guidance.quote: So, | think we should be looking at between 12% to 15% growth in terms of volume for the whole year now.

guidance.claim: The company expects to maintain its EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5% for the rest of the year.
guidance.quote: Going forward in the year, we hope to maintain the EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5%.

guidance.claim: Export contribution is expected to be between 12% and 15% for the year.
guidance.quote: 12-15% would be a good estimate for the year.

guidance.claim: Management targets reaching 5,000 crores in revenue by FY30.
guidance.quote: But we are very confident of 5,000 crores by FY30, whatever the copper price.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting a 25% CAGR for the next 3 to 4 years.
guidance.quote: 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

guidance.claim: The company expects 20% volume growth and a 5% increase in prices.
guidance.quote: Out of the 25%, we are expecting 20% volume growth and 5% increase in prices.

guidance.claim: The company expects minimum volume growth of 15% to 20% every year.
guidance.quote: Between 15% to 20% should be our volume growth minimum every year.

guidance.claim: The company is hopeful of maintaining a 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

guidance.claim: The demerged copper company is projected to reach 5,000 crores in 3 years.
guidance.quote: The Demerge Company, which will have only the copper business, will reach 5,000 crores in 3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: India is noted as one of the fastest growing copper users globally, with secondary copper demand expected to double in 5 years.
demand_outlook.quote: As we can see, India is actually one of the fastest growing copper users in the world, with around 2.4 million metric tons projected to be consumed in India by 2030.

demand_outlook.claim: The recycled copper market in India is estimated to grow at a CAGR of about 12-13%.
demand_outlook.quote: The recycled copper market, by some estimates, should be growing in India at a CAGR of about 12-13%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management sees a good future with all customers looking to increase volumes and double their capacity in the next 3 years.
demand_outlook.quote: All our customers are looking to increase their volumes and everybody is talking about doubling their capacity in the next 3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: Growing sustainability focus and supply constraints are accelerating the transition from primary to recycled copper in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Growing sustainability focus and supply constraints are accelerating the transition from primary to recycled copper in India.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects world copper consumption to double to 50 million tonnes by 2050.
demand_outlook.quote: The world consumed around 26 million tonne of copper, which is predicted to become 50 million tonne by 2050, so this is almost doubling.

demand_outlook.claim: The company foresees a big copper shortage coming after 3 or 4 years.
demand_outlook.quote: But we foresee a big shortage coming after 3 or 4 years.

capex_expansion.claim: The management proposed a capex of 40 crores over the next 2 years (FY27 and FY28).
capex_expansion.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added capacity of 35,000 metric tons which is now online.
capex_expansion.quote: We have also finished adding our capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.

capex_expansion.claim: A further capacity expansion from 35,000 to 45,000 tons is projected for next financial year between April and June.
capex_expansion.quote: So, this has been projected for the next financial year. The exact timelines are still not there, but as of now, our expectation is between April and June of next year; more likely June next year. From 35,000 to 45,000 tons.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.
capex_expansion.quote: And over here, as mentioned, we are planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to invest around 10 crores into a plastic recycling project.
capex_expansion.quote: So, right now, we are planning to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling, where the cable waste comes in, we process them into different grades, we make granules, and with aluminium and other metals, we make ingots, and then we put them back into the supply chain.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has added new heat recovery systems to increase fuel efficiency and decrease cycle times.
capex_expansion.quote: So we've also added new heat recovery systems that increase the fuel efficiency and decrease our cycle times on all our furnaces, and, that is going live this year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has started new products for AI data centers, which are silver and tin-coated bus bars.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we've included... we've started new products for AI data centers, which are silver and tin-coated bus bars.

margins_costs.claim: Removal of customs duty from 1st January 2025 helped increase margins.
margins_costs.quote: Also, the customs duty has been removed from 1st January 2025, so that has also helped us increase our margins.

margins_costs.claim: The company's EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees, and reached around 62 rupees per kg in quarter four.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees, which is very high compared to our peers, and as you can see, over the four quarters, our EBITDA per kg has been trending upwards. With the quarter four, we achieved around 62 rupees per kg.

margins_costs.claim: The company has a pass-through mechanism of copper prices to finished products.
margins_costs.quote: We have a pass-through mechanism of the copper prices to the finished products.

margins_costs.claim: The company's operational EBITDA margin is 46% and PAT margin is 2.1%.
margins_costs.quote: Our operational EBITDA margin is 46%, our PAT margin is 2.1%, and our PE ratio is 17.71%.

orders_capacity.claim: CTC wires capacity is roughly 80 metric tons a month and will increase to 150 metric tons a month.
orders_capacity.quote: On CTC wires, our capacity is roughly about 80 metric tons a month and we will be going up to 150 metric tons a month.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's capacity has reached 35,000 metric tonnes this year.
orders_capacity.quote: Our capacity has now reached 35,000 metric tonne this year, with the new, 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's copper sales volume grew by 34% to 24,000 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Last year, we did around 18,000 metric tonne of volume of copper sales. Which has gone up by 34% to, 2 24,000 metric tonne.

capital_allocation.claim: Long-term projections indicate debt will be between 300 and 350 crores in 2030.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our projection is showing that between 300 and 350 crores will be our debt in 2030.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's working capital has increased from 157 crores to 230 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our working capital has gone up from 157 crores to 230 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is looking at a fundraise of roughly about 150 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we are looking at a fundraise. We are still not, come up with a final proposal, but we are looking at a fundraise of roughly about 150 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The increase in equity was done through retained earnings rather than dilution.
capital_allocation.quote: And this increase in equity was not done through dilution, this was all done through retained earnings.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has dropped plans for lead recycling for at least the next one to one and a half years.
capital_allocation.quote: Lead recycling, for the time being, we have dropped it. At least for the next one, one and a half years, we are not looking at lead.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sourcing from the Gulf has come down and other countries' sourcing has slowed down due to transshipment delays.
risks_headwinds.quote: Whatever sourcing from Gulf has come down. Sourcing from other countries has slowed down because of transshipment in and around Gulf.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company expects volume in the first quarter to be marginally lower than the fourth quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: My volume in the first quarter might be marginally lower than fourth quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: The scrap coming from the Gulf has suddenly dried up.
risks_headwinds.quote: The scrap coming from Gulf, which is of a short duration, short lead time material, has suddenly dried up.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to execute 40 crores of capex over FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans a complete digital transformation of all processes, departments, and reporting over the next year.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next year, we are going to do a complete digital transformation of our company, where every process, every department and all reporting will be completely digitalized automatically, and no manual entry would be required.

management_commitments.claim: Management is confident of achieving 5,000 crores in revenue by FY30.
management_commitments.quote: But we are very confident of 5,000 crores by FY30, whatever the copper price.

management_commitments.claim: The government has mandated that all new products made from non-ferrous metals must contain a minimum of 5% recycled content starting from FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Government has mandated that all new products made from non-ferrous metals must contain a minimum of 5% recycled content (starting from FY28)

management_commitments.claim: The company is planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.
management_commitments.quote: And over here, as mentioned, we are planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.

management_commitments.claim: The company is hopeful of maintaining a 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year.
management_commitments.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

management_commitments.claim: The company is planning to get the value-added product mix up to 66% by the end of next year.
management_commitments.quote: So, we've already reached around 62% at the end of quarter four, and we are planning to get this up to 66% by the end of next year.

management_commitments.claim: The company hopes to execute a fundraise of roughly 150 crores in this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We hope to do it in this financial year, definitely.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
